courses.synopsis: Fundamental of vapour compression refrigeration. Analysis of refrigeration cycles. Heat pumps. Refrigerants and their properties. Absorption refrigeration. Principles of air-conditioning with emphasis on thermodynamic processes involving air-water-vapour mixture. Production of atmospheric and thermal-environments for human activity. Principles of cooling, freezing and storing of perishable products.
